title: senecio nemorensis subsp. fuchsii
intro: Senecio nemorensis subsp. fuchsii, commonly known as Wood Germander, is a plant species used in herbal medicine. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Wood Germander include its ability to relax the respiratory tract, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of colds and flu. Bioactive constituents present in Wood Germander include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
